phase_title: 実測入力データ受領後の形式検証ルール設計
phase_purpose: Phase 16 実測入力データエントリ受領・検証層：Phase 16-1 で受領した実測入力データの形式的妥当性（JSON構造、フィールド型、列挙値、必須フィールド）を検証するルールを設計する
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of format validation rules only, no actual format validation execution yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Format validation design is design-only; no actual format validation execution occurs. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual data format validation or processing is permitted.

format_validation_purpose.purpose: Ensure Phase 16-1 receipt data payload conforms to expected JSON schema, field types, and enumeration constraints before proceeding to Phase 16-2 (completeness/signature/consistency validation)
format_validation_purpose.validation_tier: Light, syntactic validation layer preceding Phase 16-2's deeper semantic validation
format_validation_purpose.validation_timing: Immediately after Phase 16-1 receipt, before Phase 16-2 processing
validation_inputs: Phase 16-1 receipt record with data payload references
Phase 15-1 integrated_decision input format specification (reference document)
Phase 15-2 receiver_validator_permission input format specification (reference document)
validation_outputs: Format validation report: PASSED / FAILED, with specific format issues listed

phase_15_1_format_validation_rules.format_spec_reference: Phase 15-1 integrated_decision final actual measurement input format specification

required_json_structure.rule: Phase 15-1 data must be valid JSON object at top level
required_json_structure.check: Parse data as JSON; must succeed without parse errors

validation_rules.rule: Value must not be empty string
Value must match reviewer ID format (e.g., alphanumeric, email-like, or UUID)
Value must be valid ISO8601 datetime string
validation_rules.check: Parse with ISO8601 parser; must succeed

validation_rules.rule: Datetime must not be in future
Datetime must be after Phase 15 approval timestamp
Array elements must be strings or valid reference objects
validation_rules.check: Each element is string or object with valid structure

validation_rules.rule: Value must be one of HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
Value must not be empty string
Value length must be reasonable for signature/token (e.g., > 20 chars, < 10000 chars)

extra_fields_rule.rule: Phase 15-1 format spec defines exact fields allowed; extra fields may be accepted or rejected per policy
extra_fields_rule.policy: ALLOW_EXTRA (extra fields ignored) or REJECT_EXTRA (validation fails if extra fields)

phase_15_2_format_validation_rules.format_spec_reference: Phase 15-2 receiver_validator_permission final actual measurement input format specification

required_json_structure.rule: Phase 15-2 data must be valid JSON object at top level
required_json_structure.check: Parse data as JSON; must succeed without parse errors

validation_rules.rule: Value must match reviewer ID format
validation_rules.check: Regex pattern matching or format validation

validation_rules.rule: Value must be valid ISO8601 datetime
Datetime must not be in future
Value must be object or string type

validation_rules.check: If string: length > 0; if object: has properties

validation_rules.rule: Array elements must be strings or valid reference objects
validation_rules.check: Each element is string or object

validation_rules.rule: Value length must be reasonable for signature/token

extra_fields_rule.rule: Same as Phase 15-1: extra fields may be allowed or rejected

step_1_determine_data_format.action: Identify the input format of Phase 15-1/15-2 data (JSON, CSV, email body, form submission, etc.)
step_1_determine_data_format.requirement: Must be parseable into JSON-like structure

step_2_convert_to_json_if_needed.action: If data is not native JSON, convert to JSON (parse CSV, extract JSON from email, etc.)
step_2_convert_to_json_if_needed.requirement: Conversion must preserve all data fields

step_3_validate_phase_15_1_json_structur.action: Apply STRUCT_15_1_JSON rule: parse as JSON
step_3_validate_phase_15_1_json_structur.fail_action: Halt; mark format validation as FAILED_INVALID_JSON

step_4_validate_phase_15_1_field_formats.action: For each field in Phase 15-1 (reviewer_id, timestamp, decision, etc.), apply field-level rules
step_4_validate_phase_15_1_field_formats.pass_criterion: All fields pass their validation rules

step_5_validate_phase_15_2_json_structur.action: Apply STRUCT_15_2_JSON rule: parse as JSON
step_5_validate_phase_15_2_json_structur.fail_action: Halt; mark format validation as FAILED_INVALID_JSON

step_6_validate_phase_15_2_field_formats.action: For each field in Phase 15-2 (reviewer_id, timestamp, permission, etc.), apply field-level rules

step_7_overall_format_result.action: Synthesize results: if ALL fields pass, PASSED_FORMAT; if ANY fail, FAILED_FORMAT

sub_elements.field_validation_results: object - for each field (reviewer_id, timestamp, decision, evidence, confidence, signature): PASS or FAIL with reason
sub_elements.failing_fields: list of fields that failed validation (if any)
sub_elements.format_issues_list: detailed issues: field name, rule failed, fail_value

sub_elements.field_validation_results: object - for each field: PASS or FAIL
sub_elements.failing_fields: list of fields that failed (if any)

overall_format_validation_result.logic: PASSED_FORMAT if both Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 are PASSED_FORMAT; FAILED_FORMAT if either is FAILED_FORMAT

recommended_next_action.logic: PROCEED if PASSED_FORMAT; REQUEST_REFORMAT if format errors are correctable; HALT if structural issues

depends_on: Phase 16-1: Receipt record and data payload storage
feeds_into: Phase 16-2: Completeness, signature, consistency validation (receives format-validated data)

design_review_checklist: Phase 15-1 format validation rules are complete (6 required fields)
Phase 15-2 format validation rules are complete (6 required fields)
Field-level rules include type checking, empty value checking, enum validation
Timestamp validation includes future/past bounds checking
Format validation procedure steps are sequential and have clear halt criteria
Report structure captures all format validation findings
Recommended actions flow logically from format validation results
Extra fields policy is defined (ALLOW_EXTRA by default)
All blocked actions remain in governance

completion_gate.gate_condition: Format validation design approved AND validation rules finalized
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 16 design authority
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 16-5 (evidence lock and tamper prevention) can begin once format design is approved
